items.title: Advancing AI for biology: Teaching models to design and characterize antibodies
items.summary: Monoclonal antibodies are one of the workhorses of biopharmaceutical development, with over 100 FDA-approved drugs and well-established manufacturing, regulatory, and clinical-development pathways.
